reviewNotes: Reviewed all source pairs for proposal actor gender, relationship intent, 3-day ceremony and 14-day child arrival, caret and repeated placeholders. Explicit Male/Female contexts use appropriate pronouns; common clauses are gender-neutral. Gift categories follow the reviewed preference glossary. Fruit tree name kept as parenthetical name to avoid inflection guesses. Command names remain dynamic and argument descriptions are visible help text.
